paite: Huan Jerubbaal tapa Abimelek Shekem ah anu sanggampate kiang ah ahoh a, anu' pa inkote tengteng ahoupih hi.
heading: Abimelek

paite: "Shekem a mi tengteng zak in thu gen unla, 'Jerubbaal tapa tengteng mi sawm-sagihte'n na tung ua vai ahawm uhia hoih na sak uh, mi khat in na tung ua vai ahawm?' Gen dih ua, kei leng na guh uh leh na sa uh hi sam ka hi, chih theigige un," chi in agen hi.
Anu sanggampate'n Shekem a mi tengteng zak in huai thu tengteng agen uh. Huchi in Abimelek zuih utna lungsim ahon puta ua, "Amah i unau ahi,” achi ngal ua.
Baal-berith inn a pan dangka sawmsagih apia ua, huai zang in Abimelek in amah zui, mingongtat leh migina lou pipite aguai hi.
Ophrah a apa inn ah ava hoh a, Jerubbaal tapate, a-unau sawmsagihte suang khat tung ah athat hi. Jerubbaal tapa naupangpen Jotham bel ana kibuk ziak in athat kha kei hi.
Shekem a mi tengteng leh Beth-millo a mi tengteng akikaikhawm ua, Shekem a suangphuh bul tosaw kiang ah kumpipa in Abimelek abawlta uhi.

Hiai Jotham ahilh uleh Gerizim tang ah ahohtou a, avum ah ava dingh a, aw ngaihtak in akikou a, akiang uah, "Nou Shekem a mite aw, ka thugen ngaikhe dih ua, huchi in Pathian mah in leng nou thu ahon ngaikhe sam ding hi:
heading: Jotham In Shekem Mite Ataihilh

paite: Khatvei atung ua kumpipa ding thaunilh ding in singte akuankhia ua; olive sing kiang ah, 'Nang ka kumpipa hi in,' achi uhi.
Himahleh olive sing in akiang uah, 'Pathian leh mihing pahtawina dia azat pen uh ka thau nusia in singte tung ah dopsang in ka om ding maw?' achi hi.
Singte'n theipi kung kiang ah, 'Kisa dih, nang ka kumpipa ding un hong om in,' ava chi uhi.
Himahleh theipi kung in akiang uah, 'Ka khumna leh ka gah hoihtak nusia in singte tung ah dopsang in ka om ding maw?' achi hi.
Singte'n grepgui kiang ah, 'Kisa dih, nang ka kumpipa ding un om in aw?' achi uh.
Grepgui in akiang uah, 'Pathian leh mihing kipaksak ka uain nusia in singte tung ah dopsang in ka om ding maw?' achi hi.
Huchi in sing tengteng in lingvom kiang ah, ‘Kisa in, nang ka kumpipa ding un om in,' achi uhi.

Lingvom in singte kiang ah, 'Na kumpipa ding ua thau hon nilh taktak na hih uleh ka liim ah hong bu in hon muang un; huchi ahihkeileh ling a pan mei hong pawt henla Lebanon tang a sidar singte kang khin hen,' achi hi.
"Huaiziak in tu in chihtaktak a Abimelek na kumpipa ua bawl na hih ua, Jerubbaal leh a-inkote hoihtak a bawl a akituahpih bang a, atung a na hih ua;
Ka pa'n gal ahon dousak a ana sihloh hialta a, Midiante khut a pan in noute ahon hunkheta hi.
Tuni in ka pa inkote tung ah na hel ua, atapate sawmsagih tak suang khat tung ah na that ua, na unaupa uh ahih ziak in asikhanu tapa Abimelek, Shekem khomite kumpipa ding in lah na bawlta ngal ua.
Tuni a Jerubbaal leh a-inkote tung a chihtaktak a gamta na hih uleh, Abimelek tung ah kipak unla, amah leng na tung uah kipak hen.

Himahleh huchibang ahihkeileh Abimelek a pan mei hong kuangkhia henla, Shekem a mite leh Beth-millo mite kangtum hen. Shekem a mite leh Beth-millo a pan meikuang hong pawt henla, Abimelek kangtum vek hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Jotham atai a, ataimang a, Beer ah atai a, a-unaupa Abimelek alauh ziak in huai ah atengta hi.
Abimelek in Israelte tung ah kum thum vai ahawm hi.
heading: Abimelek Puksiatna

paite: Pathian in Abimelek leh Shekem a mite kikal ah kha gilou asawl hi. Huchi in Shekem khomite Abimelek tung ah lepchiahtak in agamta uhi.

Huai ahihleh Jerubbaal tapa sawmsagihte tung a mulkimhuaitak a, agamtat ziak a atung a phulakna ahong tuntheihna ding leh amaute thatpa a-unaupa uh Abimelek tung a leh a-unaute that ding a amah ana panpih Shekemte tung a, asisan uh a-omtheihna ding ahi.
Shekem a mite'n mualvumte ah amah guktan mite akoih ua, huai mun a va pai peuhmah ana suam ua; huai thu Abimelek ahilh uhi.
Ebed tapa Gaal, a-unaute toh ahong kuan ua, Shekem ah alut ua; Shekemte'n ana muangmoh kei uh.
Lou lam ah ahoh ua, agrephuan ua grepte alou ua, achil ua, vualnop abawl ua, apathian inn uah alut ua, ne a dawn in Abimelek ahamsiat uhi.

Ebed tapa Gaal in, "Eite'n a-nna uh i sepsak ding, Abimelek kua ahia? Shekem mah leng kua ahia? Jerubbaal tapa ahi kei maw? Zebul, asepaih makai hilou amaw? Shekem pa Hamor mite nna sem ding maw? Bangziak in ahita amah nna i sep ding uh?
Hiai mite ka khut nuai ah om le uh aw! Abimelek ka lakhe ding." Abimelek kiang ah, "Na sepaihte pungsak inla, hong paikhia in," achi hi.
Huai kho vaihawmpa Zebul in Ebed tapa Gaal thugen azak in, aheh tohthoh in a-om hi.
Huchi in gitlouhpil in, Abimelek kiang ah, "Ngai in, Ebed tapa Gaal leh a-unaute Shekem ah ahong uh. Ngai in, na tung a hel tum in na khua a mite ahanthawn uhi.
Huchi in na mite toh kisa unla, zan in loubuk ah na tang un.

Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, zingsang a ni asuah chiang in, beltak in thou inla, khua hong dou mai in. Ngai in, amah leh alawite'n nang hon dou dek chiang un, hoih na sak dandan in atung uah na hih mai ding hi," chi a hilh ding in mite ataisak hi.
Huchi in Abimelek leh ami tengteng zan in athou ua, pawl li a kikhen in Shekem khua ava umta uhi.
Ebed tapa Gaal ava pawt a, khopi lutna kongpi ah ava dingh a, Abimelek leh amite aguktanna ua kipan ahong kuanta uhi.
Gaal in mipite amuh in Zebul kiang ah, "Ngai in, mualvum a pan mipite ahong paisuk uh," achi hi. Zebul in akiang ah, "Mihing bang a mual lim mu hilel teh," achi hi.
Gaal in, "En tanla, gam laitak ah mipi ahong paisuk uh. Pawl khatte houh aisan siampa tosaw sing lampi ah ahong pai uh,” achi nawn hi.
Huchi in Zebul in akiang ah, "Abimelek kua ahia, a-nna i sep ding pen uh? chi a na genna kam koi a omta ahia? Hiaite na mimuhsitte mah hilou uhia? Va pawtkhia inla, va dou in," achi hi.
Huchi in Gaal in Shekemte makai in Abimelek ava douta hi.
Abimelek in ana delh a, ataisia a, khopi tan in mi tampi liam in apuk uhi.
Abimelek bel Arumah ah ateng hi. Zebul in Gaal leh a-unaute Shekem a teng thei lou ding in adelhkhe vek hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in mipite loubuk ah apawtkhia uh chih Abimelek ahilh uhi.
Mipite api a, pawl thum in akhen a, loubuk ah aguktan ua; adak a, ngai in, mipite khopi a pan ahong pawtkhia ua, huchi in amau ana sual ua, athatta uhi.
Abimelek leh apawlte malam ah atai ua, khopi lutna kongpi ah adingh ua, pawl nihte'n loubuk a omte tengteng apumboh ua, athatta uhi.
Abimelek in khopi huai ni in nitum in asual a; huchi in khopi ala a, asung a mite athat a, khopi ahihse vek a; chitui in atheh hi.
Shekem kulh a omte tengteng in huai thu ana za ua, Berith pathian insung bitna mun ah atailut uhi.
Shekem kulh a mi tengteng a-omkhawm vek uh chih Abimelek ahilh uhi.

Abimelek leh akiang a om tengteng Zalmon tang ah ahohtou uhi. Abimelek in heipi atawi a, singhiang asatkhia a, apua a, akiang a om amite kiang ah, "Ka hihdan na mu uh, ka hih bang in nou leng hih mengmeng un," achi hi.

Mi tengteng in singhiang asatkhe chiat ua, Abimelek hih bang in apua ua, inn kulhpi kim ah asekhawm ua, kulhpi sung a omte ahalkhum uhi. Huchi in Shekem Kulhpi sung a om tengteng asi vek ua, pasal leh numei teng sangkhat vel ahi uh.
Huchi in Thebez ah Abimelek ahoh a, Thebez khua a-um a, alata hi.
Himahleh huai khopi sung ah kulhpi kiptak a-om a, huai ah pasal leh numei tengteng leh khopi sung a mi tengteng atailut ua, akikhakkhum bikbek ua, kulh tung ah a-omkhawm uhi.
Abimelek bel kulh lam ah ahoh a, ava dou a, hal ding in kulh kongpi ah ahoh hi.
Numei kuahiam in Abimelek lutung khat gawizanna suang akhesuk a, aluguh akitam hi.
Huchi in agalvan tawipa tangval asam pah a, akiang ah, "Na namsau phawi inla, hon that mai in. Huchi a mite'n, 'Numei thah ahi,' ahon chihlouhna ding un," achi hi.
Israelte'n Abimelek asi chih atheihtak un, a-inn lam chiat uah apaita uhi.
Abimelek in a-unau sawmsagihte athah leh apa tung a giloutak a atatsiatna Pathian in hiai bang in athukta hi.
Shekem khomite gitlouhna tengteng Pathian in athuk samta hi. Jerubbaal tapa Jotham hamsiat amau tung ah ahong tungta hi.
